APEX // CLEAN SERVICE PATTERN AccountProvisioningService.cls • Bulkified & Zero Code Debt 
// Production-grade Apex Service Layer with Strict Bulkification
public inherited sharing class AccountProvisioningService {
  public static void syncEnterpriseAccounts(List<Id> accountIds) {
    if (accountIds == null || accountIds.isEmpty()) return;
    
    // Bulkified Selector Layer with Security Enforced
    List<Account> records = [
      SELECT Id, Name, Active_Subscription__c, Telemetry_UUID__c
      FROM Account
      WHERE Id IN :accountIds
      WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED
    ];
    
    // Enqueue Async Queueable Job to Prevent Governor Limits
    System.enqueueJob(new ExternalMiddlewareSyncJob(records));
  }
}
Engineering Methodology

A Developer-Led Salesforce Delivery Framework

We treat Salesforce like a first-class enterprise software platform: requirements become architecture, architecture becomes tested code, and releases move through safe staging sandboxes.

05
